message.reasoning_content:
The user wants me to classify the relationship between two yes/no questions extracted from speeches by the same actor at different times.

Question 1: "As pessoas com dor crônica devem ser incluídas no diagnóstico biopsicossocial?" (Should people with chronic pain be included in the biopsychosocial diagnosis?)
Question 2: "O cuidado deve ser reconhecido como trabalho?" (Should care be recognized as work?)

These questions are about completely different topics. Question 1 is about including people with chronic pain in a biopsychosocial diagnosis. Question 2 is about recognizing care as work. They are not the same question, nor do they have opposite polarities. They are different questions.

Relation: DIFFERENT
